owasp-security.author: felipeblassioli
owasp-security.description: Dispatcher skill mapping Node.js/TypeScript backend security questions to OWASP Top 10 (2021) categories and library-specific references (express, mysql2, auth, SSRF). Use for backend security review, parameterizing mysql2 queries, hardening Express middleware. Do NOT use for React/frontend XSS, ORM specifics (Prisma/Knex), or cloud/K8s posture.

frontend-contract-discovery.author: felipeblassioli
frontend-contract-discovery.description: Find the HTTP contracts a React frontend consumes, drafts an evidence-backed OpenAPI spec, and records traceable findings in discover.log.md. Use when the user wants to infer API behavior from frontend code instead of reviewing a backend-owned source of truth.

react-native-skills.author: vercel
react-native-skills.description: React Native and Expo best practices

go-package-documentation.author: felipeblassioli
go-package-documentation.description: Go package documentation (doc.go) following official conventions

go-command-line-applications.author: felipeblassioli
go-command-line-applications.description: Author and review serious Go command-line applications with stable command grammar, explicit side effects, predictable output contracts, and thin CLI adapter boundaries.

tdd-classicist.author: felipeblassioli
tdd-classicist.description: Classicist TDD methodology with Meszaros test-double taxonomy

esm-typescript.author: felipeblassioli
esm-typescript.description: Diagnose and fix ESM errors in TypeScript projects

typescript-quality.author: felipeblassioli
typescript-quality.description: TypeScript quality patterns and best practices

typescript-testing-organization.author: felipeblassioli
typescript-testing-organization.description: TypeScript test file suffixes, layout, and tier-suffix policy

ts-module-documentation.author: felipeblassioli
ts-module-documentation.description: Ensure TypeScript modules and public exports are documented with clear JSDoc purpose and API details.

typescript-error-handling.author: felipeblassioli
typescript-error-handling.description: TypeScript error handling patterns inspired by ZIO: expected vs unexpected failures, typed domain errors, and robust recovery strategies.

vercel-deploy-claimable.author: vercel
vercel-deploy-claimable.description: Deploy apps to Vercel with claimable ownership transfer

commit-hygiene.author: felipeblassioli
commit-hygiene.description: Commit hygiene and self-contained pull requests. Highlights production impact, uses gh CLI for opening/updating PRs, and adding proof comments (test runs, coverage reports).

code-review.author: anthropics
code-review.description: Use when reviewing code changes, pull requests, or code audits and you need a structured pass over correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and testing gaps.

deno-production-practices.author: felipeblassioli
deno-production-practices.description: Production-grade Deno guidance centered on least-privilege permissions, ESM-first dependency strategy, Deno-native testing and style conventions, and deliberate Node/npm interoperability.

firebase-functions-node.author: felipeblassioli
firebase-functions-node.description: Guide writing, configuring, testing, and migrating Firebase Cloud Functions for Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript). Distinguish v1 (deprecated) from v2 functions by import path. Use when writing a new Cloud Function, adding a trigger (HTTP, PubSub, Firestore), configuring environment or secrets, testing functions locally or with firebase-functions-test, or migrating v1 functions to v2. Do NOT use for client-side Firebase SDK integration, GCP services unrelated to Cloud Functions, or test-tier selection methodology (see tdd-classicist). ---

gcloud-logging.author: felipeblassioli
gcloud-logging.description: Query and extract Google Cloud Logging entries using the Logging query language DSL and gcloud CLI. Covers Cloud Run, Firebase Functions (1st gen), GKE, Compute Engine, and other GCP resource types. Use when the user asks to read logs, debug Cloud Run errors, tail Firebase Functions output, build Logging filters, parse log entries, or investigate GCP service behavior via logs.

gcp-error-reporting-nodejs.author: felipeblassioli
gcp-error-reporting-nodejs.description: Set up and use Google Cloud Error Reporting in Node.js applications. Covers automatic capture on Cloud Run / Cloud Run functions, the @google-cloud/error-reporting client library (configuration + middleware), and Cloud Logging log-entry formatting rules for Error Reporting ingestion.

gcp-opentelemetry-nodejs.author: felipeblassioli
gcp-opentelemetry-nodejs.description: OpenTelemetry explicit instrumentation and Google Cloud structured logging/error-reporting patterns for Node.js workloads.

gh-pr-creator.author: felipeblassioli
gh-pr-creator.description: Create and update GitHub pull requests using gh CLI for repositories that use a `.github/pull_request_template.md` with comment markers. PRs are written in Brazilian Portuguese and use `.work/` staging files for the body.

gh-post-code-review.author: felipeblassioli
gh-post-code-review.description: Post a structured code review (markdown with BLOCKER/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/QUESTION sections and Cursor-style start:end:path code refs) to a GitHub PR. Favors `gh pr review`; falls back to `gh api POST /pulls/{n}/reviews` for multi-comment, side-aware, or draft reviews. Maps verdict to the right review event, guards against head-SHA drift, and adapts addressing to the PR author. Use when the user has a written review and a PR URL/number and wants it submitted.

hurl-testing.author: felipeblassioli
hurl-testing.description: Write, execute, and assert HTTP requests safely using Hurl text files.

kysely-typescript.author: felipeblassioli
kysely-typescript.description: Type-safe SQL query building in TypeScript using Kysely. Use when writing or reviewing Kysely queries, schema types, migrations, raw SQL snippets, dynamic filters, conditional selects, transactions, or reusable query helpers.

linear-specialist.author: felipeblassioli
linear-specialist.description: Audit and tidy Linear boards using MCP-first evidence, with focused checks for hierarchy, labels, statuses, stale work, and whether Linear still reflects the current reality of work.

nested-agents-routing.author: felipeblassioli
nested-agents-routing.description: Design repository-local agent guidance using root and nested AGENTS.md files, scoped Cursor rules, reusable skills, pack-owned runtime assets, and optional pack-bundled skills.

gh-issue-verifier.author: felipeblassioli
gh-issue-verifier.description: Verify whether a GitHub issue is implemented in the current codebase by collecting evidence from the issue, git history, docs, code, and tests, then producing a structured report with verdict, proof, gaps, confidence, and scope-clarity doubts.

hono-htmx-server.author: felipeblassioli
hono-htmx-server.description: Build and review server-side HTMX applications with Hono using HTML fragment responses, typed HTMX attributes, and production-safe server patterns.

bmad-specialist.author: felipeblassioli
bmad-specialist.description: Audit and customize installed BMAD projects by inspecting `_bmad/` customizations, interviewing the team about current process, and deciding whether behavior belongs in memory, role overrides, workflows/checklists, or reusable skills.

github-actions-release-topology.author: felipeblassioli
github-actions-release-topology.description: Use when creating, reviewing, or hardening GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows where deployment topology, promotion safety, release identity, cache discipline, OIDC, environments, or production readiness matter.

prd.author: felipeblassioli
prd.description: Use when the user asks to draft or refine a Product Requirements Document with clear scope, measurable success criteria, and implementation-ready requirement structure.

babysit.author: felipeblassioli
babysit.description: Keep a PR merge-ready by triaging comments (including Bugbot), resolving clear merge conflicts, and fixing CI in a loop until the branch is mergeable. Invoke explicitly when the user wants a PR babysat.

blassioli-code-reviewer.author: felipeblassioli
blassioli-code-reviewer.description: Use when reviewing code changes, PRs, diffs, or implementation plans where HTTP services, scheduled jobs, queue consumers, Kubernetes runtime behavior, webhooks, dual-writes, caches, multi-tenant data, money/units, time-sensitive logic, feature flags, error handling (failure/defect/fatal taxonomy, retry classification, boundary translation), idempotency, retries, observability, or distributed-systems safety matter.

backend-contract-reconciliation.author: felipeblassioli
backend-contract-reconciliation.description: Take draft endpoint artifacts produced by frontend-contract-discovery and reconcile them with backend implementation truth using strict trace sources.

otel-semantic-conventions.author: dash0
otel-semantic-conventions.description: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions expert. Use when selecting, applying, or reviewing telemetry attributes. Triggers on tasks involving attribute selection, semantic convention compliance, attribute migration, or custom attribute decisions. Covers the attribute registry, naming patterns, attribute placement, and versioning. For span names, span kinds, and span status codes, see the otel-instrumentation skill.
